summary: Rabbi Sutton discusses Yom HaZikaron and Yom HaAtzmaut, focusing on the soldiers who paid the ultimate sacrifice for Eretz Israel. He mentions visiting Har HaZikaron and quotes Rabbi Meir Mazuz regarding Olam HaBa for these soldiers.
